name: Tree LOD Chain with Instancing
definition: A multi-stage LOD system for trees, chosen by projected size per tree or chunk, ranging from full voxels to baked heightfields, using instancing for distant stages to reduce CPU overhead.
summary: Tree LOD Chain with Instancing is a multi-stage volumetric tree system that uses projected size to select LODs, employing instancing for distant stages to reduce CPU overhead and unify transitions via canonical crowns.
